title: Pharma SaaS compliance platform
summary: Centralised compliance and drug-distribution reporting for a global pharmaceutical client.
impact: Global reporting time cut by 50%, with better compliance accuracy.
problem: A global pharmaceutical client lacked a centralised SaaS system for compliance and accurate drug-distribution reporting.
solution: Built an enterprise SaaS platform to aggregate and visualise large volumes of pharma data, with automated data pipelines for real-time accuracy and scale across stakeholders.
result: Reduced global reporting time by 50%, improved compliance accuracy and delivered insights faster to global pharma partners.
